''See also: [[Tyrfang Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Tyrfang, also known as the executioner's blade, is a legendary [[sword]] that predates the existence of The Empire{{!}}the Empire. The weapon features a black metal blade marked by veins of bright red light that resemble flowing [[blood]]. It possesses an incredibly potent and hostile [[aura]], characterized by a sense of overwhelming dread, despair, and macabre madness. This corrupting influence is so strong that the blade can blight the earth, causing [[stone]] to peel away or ground to die wherever it is wielded. The weapon's power is so intense that its presence can paralyze those nearby with fear or cause even seasoned individuals to feel as though they are facing their own death. Historically, the [[sword]] was forged by a man named Jorin Curse-breaker{{!}}Jorin, who is capable of recognizing its power. The weapon has been passed down through the [[Guilds]], and because it is difficult to bond with, only those capable of surviving its lethal intent can inherit the [[Guild]]. Currently, the blade is wielded by [[Jarelys Teach]], the General and Head of the [[Imperial Guard]]. [[Teach]] became its [[Vessel]] after surviving its intent through the use of a [[Bonereaver]]'s heart. While she cannot empower the blade like a [[Magister]], her focused intent allows her to utilize its dark power in combat.}}

== Of Dawn and Darkness ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|Tyrfang is a black metal [[sword]] characterized by its rough texture and veins of bright red. Also known as the Executioner’s Blade, this weapon radiates a hostile and corrosive intent that is capable of striking humans dead. Held by [[Teach]], the blade can release dark power and is associated with the intent used by its wielder. While the bearer of the [[sword]] once provided [[Calder]] with a tour, it is believed that Jorin Curse-breaker{{!}}Jorin Maze-walker was likely the one who Awakened the weapon.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">10</span></div>

== Of Darkness and Dawn ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|Tyrfang is a legendary executioner's blade characterized by its black metal and a channel of red light. This weapon, which emanates an [[aura]] of dread, was claimed by [[Teach]] to serve as her vessel. As an object carried by a bearer, the [[sword]] releases a red-tinted Shadow{{!}}shadow whenever it is utilized. Ultimately, the blade functions with a lethal intent during combat.}}

The blade itself is rotten and corrupting in nature. This weapon possesses enough power to blight entire forests with every single cut it makes.}}
